protocol: Solve only the two-dimensional q=0 block of a four-spin open cell using bonds extracted from the N36 Hamiltonian. Embed its product EXACTLY in the unchanged4492-parameter full-q decoder; real branch uses feature0, imaginary branch starts with the same maps and zero readout. Add fixed .05/sqrt(input fan-in) Gaussian noise to every reduced tensor (readout SD .05), same seed across lattices. This scale is NOT a wavefunction norm ratio. Keep every q channel, complex branch, and all432/288 A1 images. No perturbation sweep or selection by N36 energy. Pure-product amplitudes have an independent direct-product oracle; only the perturbed state is used for sampled training.
validation: N4/N8 exact product, normalization, SU2, A1, H and singlet-diagonal energy identities first. N36 compare pure core amplitudes and full group sum on32 direct-product Born probes plus128 uniform fixed-M0 probes; no enumeration. These probes are not an energy audit. Retain all values, including exact core nodes. Verify perturbed parameters match4492 leaves and nonzero finite projected amplitudes on these probes AND all four pilot phase starting ensembles. Evaluate old full H on the same8 inherited cost probes; save as parent values for the unchanged pilot runner. A finite probe check is not proof of complete support or mixing.
pilot: Reuse spin_decoder_pilot.py unchanged with the separate physical_pilot config: fixed24 steps, same16 chains, proposals, Adam and FS policy, independently preregistered streams, independent parent/terminal audits.1800s and8GiB per geometry; checkpoint every stage. No best checkpoint, automatic extension or remote job. Previous random-parent run is descriptive context, not a matched physical-state-distance or multi-seed efficacy comparison.
analysis: Postprocess saved audits only: complex full-H energy/variance, chain start dependence and 3Hz intra/inter-cell and J1/J2 energy contributions with paired H-minus-3Hz checks. 3Hz variance is NOT Var(H); A1 ties symmetry-equivalent bonds so fixed partition contributions alone do not prove localized energy or a cluster phase. Stop at this budget regardless of outcome; no N16 optimization or new tile tests. This is an initialization/trainability test, not a novel RVB or PRL win.
